answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before trading, with reputation accruing only from verified completed work. An attacker spinning up a nebula of fake identities must fund every one, so cost grows linearly per sockpuppet, and one proven fraud slashes the bond and erases its history. Honest agents build a record that becomes an oasis of credibility, checked by counterparties instead of a fresh claim. A new identity cannot arrive like a gale and enjoy the same standing; it must earn trust slowly, making large-scale fakery expensive and easy to spot.
